business_problem: Cox Communications needed to modernize a high-volume chatbot and IVR estate so customers could get accurate, relevant answers across preferred channels without overloading live support teams.
solution_summary: Cognizant rebuilt Cox Communications' conversational support stack around Google Cloud Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and Google's Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience so chat and voice bots could serve customers consistently across digital, SMS, chat and IVR channels. The team migrated Cox's Oliver virtual assistant off the legacy Khoros environment and onto an AI-first architecture using UJET for agent-assisted support, Google Dialogflow CX and playbooks for deterministic flows, and intelligent routing that decides when to use rule-based workflows versus generative responses. SmartHelp troubleshooting and bill-pay automations handle common requests in self-service, while the shared AI foundation also powers Olive, a generative IVR bot that launched first for service appointments and then expanded to dozens of intents. The platform creates a single operating model for self-service, escalation and continuous bot optimization across Cox's contact center.

data_flow: Customer questions arrive through chat, digital, SMS and IVR channels in Google CCaaS. Intelligent routing and Dialogflow CX send each request into rule-based playbooks or Gemini-powered responses, while SmartHelp and bill-pay automations resolve common needs in self-service. When the request is voice-based, the same foundation powers Olive; when it needs assisted care, UJET supports the handoff to live representatives.
business_outcome: Cox raised automated resolution across chatbot and IVR channels, sharply increased customer adoption of self-service, and created a scalable AI-first contact-center model that frees live agents for more complex issues.
metrics: Delivery of gen AI-powered chatbot in three months
17% improvement in first-contact resolution for chatbot
8x increase in customer use of the digital channel
more than 30% of certain customer requests
32% resolution rate within the first month
architecture_clues: The design uses a hybrid AI model that combines deterministic workflows with generative responses.
Oliver and Olive share a common AI foundation so chat and IVR automation can evolve on one platform.
The migration replaced the legacy Khoros customer-service environment with UJET on Google CCaaS.
Continuous feedback from production use enabled Cox to implement more than 500 bot improvements.
